In circuits deep and data wide,
A cyber jellyfish does glide.
Its tendrils flash with neon light,
In the digital ocean's night.

Through binary currents it does float,
A creature from the cyber boat.
With pulses soft and glow so bright,
It swims through waves of ones and zeros tonight.

A dancer in the digital sea,
Where dreams and data meet in harmony.
